description:
APP Kirrane Auctioneering are delighted to present this splendid two bedroom ground floor apartment to the market.  This property offers spacious living and sleeping accommodation.  A delightful patio area overlooking the River Moy and private parking space.  The property is accessed via a key coded front door.  
Located close to the world famous Foxford Wollen Mills, a vairety of amenities and service providers, ample locations for fishing, scenic walks and historical buildings.  Only a short drive to Ballina, Casltebar, Ireland West Airport, Knock Shrine, Lough Key Forest Walks, to mention just a few.  An ideal location for first time buyers, retirees, holiday home or an investment property.

Accommodation consists of entrance hallway, open plan kitchen come dining and living area fitted with ample worktop and storage space.  Overlooking the River Moy.  Timber flooring with tiled floor in the kitchen area.  Electric fire and electric heating fitted throughout.  Large tiled bathroom, fitted with white bathroom ware.  Two double bedrooms with fitted wardrobes and timber flooring.  

The property is nicely presented and offers an even flow throughout.  For further information or to arrange viewing please contact the Sole Selling Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering where everything we touch turns to SOLD.
